thread:
emily: quick question  for the new settings form do we standardize on an asterisk or explicit 'Required' text? asterisk feels terse but saves space on mobile :iphone:
jas: asterisk + programmatic mark (aria-required) is fine for density if we increase contrast and make it keyboard discoverable. tiny asterisks get lost when users zoom
omar: prefer progressive reveal: a small indicator by default, reveal 'Required' + short reason on focus/hover. avoids clutter but keeps clarity. avoid using placeholder text for required state
morgan: product note  some fields become required only based on config (eg. enterprise-only). can we show the reason in the tooltip, not permanent helper text? avoids noise for most users
a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: 1) always set aria-required on the control 2) if using a tooltip for reason, ensure a keyboard-focusable trigger and aria-describedby points to it 3) do not rely on color alone
emily: got it. implementation idea: CSS ::after minimal glyph, on :focus expand to inline 'Required' text without shifting layout (overlay). tooltip shows policy reason when applicable
jas: also want error placement takeaways: inline under field for single-field errors; a compact top banner with anchors for cross-field or >2 errors. banner should be role=alert and contain links that focus respective fields
omar: dev implementation: add data-error-id attrs and auto-focus first invalid on submit. server should return field-level ids to populate aria-describedby
morgan: deletion flow debate: typed confirm vs checkbox? current modal is checkbox "I understand". typed confirm slows power users but prevents mistakes
jas: suggest risk-tiered rules: low-risk items -> destructive CTA + undo toast; high-risk/prod -> typed confirm + list of linked resources. threshold can be size or prod flag
a11y-bot: typed confirm notes: input should have clear label, autocomplete="off", and a live region to announce mismatch/errors. ensure screen readers get the instruction when modal opens
emily: agree on graduated approach. also show brief consequences summary (eg. "this will remove snapshots and break X pipelines") in the modal to help decisioning
morgan: add an escape hatch: if typed confirm is required, include a short checkbox "I understand the consequences" for assistive tech users who can't type easily, but still require a persistent affordance (discuss with accessibility team)
a11y-bot: caution: alternatives to typed confirm must still be strong enough to avoid accidental deletes. document and test with screen reader users
deploy-bot: FYI  design token 'indicator-contrast' update scheduled 03:00 UTC tomorrow, please validate new value against a11y checklist
emily: thanks everyone  i'll sketch compact+expanded mocks and an acceptance checklist (aria-required, aria-describedby, focus-first-invalid, error-banner behavior, delete-tier rules) and post in this thread later today :memo:
